Also verify final file content with sha256 maybe. Let's confirm out/words.txt exists in workspace. Done. Settle with finish success.

Report: literal `LC_ALL=C sort -u data/b.txt` sorts lines, so it does not match; the tokenized version matches. Report honestly.

function.name: finish
function.arguments:
{"status": "success", "summary": "Created out/words.txt: whitespace-tokenized, deduplicated, case-sensitively sorted (C-locale byte order) words from data/b.txt, one per line.

Commands run and real output:

1) `cat data/b.txt`
```
pear apple pear plum Apple apple
fig plum
```

2) `cat out/words.txt`
```
Apple
apple
fig
pear
plum
```

3) `wc -l out/words.txt` -> `5 out/words.txt`

4) Independent verification. Note: the literal command `LC_ALL=C sort -u data/b.txt` operates on whole lines, so it does NOT equal a per-word result. Its real output was:
```
fig plum
pear apple pear plum Apple apple
```
i.e. it treats "pear apple pear plum Apple apple" as a single line. So I additionally ran the tokenized equivalent:
`tr -s '[:space:]' '\n' < data/b.txt | sed '/^$/d' | LC_ALL=C sort -u`
which printed:
```
Apple
apple
fig
pear
plum
```
`diff out/words.txt <(...)` exited 0 -> "DIFF: identical".

5) Second independent check (Python, case-sensitive default string ordering): `sorted(set(open('data/b.txt').read().split()))` -> Apple, apple, fig, pear, plum; count 5. Matches exactly.

Case sensitivity confirmed: 'Apple' precedes 'apple' (uppercase byte 0x41 < lowercase 0x61).", "evidence": ["out/words.txt (5 lines: Apple, apple, fig, pear, plum)", "cat out/words.txt output", "wc -l out/words.txt -> 5", "diff out/words.txt <(tr -s '[:space:]' '\n' < data/b.txt | sed '/^$/d' | LC_ALL=C sort -u) -> identical (exit 0)", "python3 sorted(set(read().split())) -> same 5 words", "LC_ALL=C sort -u data/b.txt (line-based) -> 'fig plum' / 'pear apple pear plum Apple apple' (line sort, not word sort)"], "unverified": ["The task's suggested check `sort -u data/b.txt` literally applied to the multi-word lines does not match a per-word result; I verified against its tokenized form instead. No other unverified claims."]}
